tools.name: get_account_overview
tools.description: When: start of trading session before any decision. Combines risk + portfolio + live. Resilient: if live fails, returns the rest. include_live=false for quick summary without live account. read-only.

tools.name: get_risk_status
tools.description: When: session start or before mode change. kill switch, limits, mode, executionEnv. Do not use instead of get_trade_readiness for immediate forex. read-only. Returns envelope { ok, data }.

tools.name: get_trade_readiness
tools.description: When: before open_trade forex or quoteAgeMs>5000. Do not execute if ready=false. read-only. Example: symbol=EURUSD&confidence=85&market=forex.

tools.name: get_agent_capabilities
tools.description: When: first message in session. serverVersion, featureFlags, EA debounce. read-only. No side-effects.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: When: after get_account_overview or to refresh PnL. Balance and summary. read-only. Not for execution.

tools.name: get_open_trades
tools.description: When: before evaluate_trade or close. Open trades + summary_ar. read-only.

tools.name: get_trade_lessons
tools.description: When: before every analysis or after a loss. recent=true for recent mistakes. read-only. Example: symbol=EURUSD&recent=true.

tools.name: create_recommendation
tools.description: When: before open_trade — record recommendation. rationale 2–4 sentences in 'we' voice. side-effect: writes recommendation. Example: action=buy&confidence=85.

tools.name: open_trade
tools.description: When: after explicit approval. stop_loss mandatory (Risk Guard rejects without it); pass entry/take_profit for reward/risk (rejected if below minimum). notional optional — if omitted, size derived from stop distance. Rejects stale quotes. Decision from agent analysis (no confidence threshold — confidence for logging/sizing only). idempotencyKey optional. side-effect: executes via Risk Guard. Example: stop_loss=64000&take_profit=68000&approved_by_user=true.

tools.name: close_trade
tools.description: Close trade · close position · exit · close position · fully exit. When: operator request or after record_exit_decision=close. side-effect: closes trade/all. Example: trade_id=123.

tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description: When: open trade and operator request. Live PnL + context. read-only. Example: trade_id=42.

tools.name: record_exit_decision
tools.description: When: after evaluate_trade. audit hold/close/adjust_sl. side-effect: records decision. Does not auto-close.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Request approval · trade approval · send for approval · approval buttons. When: mode=approval. Sends Telegram buttons. side-effect: pending intent. Do not use in direct mode.

tools.name: respond_approval
tools.description: When: pending intent. approve/reject. side-effect: may execute on approve.

tools.name: get_pending_approvals
tools.description: When: mode=approval. List of pending intents. read-only.

tools.name: get_execution_env
tools.description: When: before live trade. demo/live + platforms. read-only.

tools.name: set_execution_env
tools.description: When: switch demo↔live with approval. side-effect: changes preference. Do not use automatically.

tools.name: set_trading_mode
tools.description: When: switch auto/approval/direct. side-effect: changes mode. direct recommended for chat.

tools.name: get_agent_settings
tools.description: When: before futures or market change. active_market, leverage. read-only.

tools.name: set_active_market
tools.description: When: confirm active market (forex-only platform). side-effect: no-op — always forex.

tools.name: set_futures_enabled
tools.description: When: never needed — legacy no-op. Futures disabled; platform is forex-only. Always returns futures_enabled=false. read-only.

tools.name: run_trade_maintenance
tools.description: When: mechanical OCO/TP maintenance. side-effect: may modify orders. Not a substitute for analysis.

tools.name: send_telegram_menu
tools.description: When: outbound notification. side-effect: Telegram message. Not interactive chat.

tools.name: capture_chart_snapshot
tools.description: When: with every recommendation. PNG inline + drawings. read-only on market; side-effect: capture. Example: symbol=EURUSD&interval=1h.

tools.name: get_recommendation_chart
tools.description: When: after create_recommendation. PNG chart for recommendation. Old recommendations without chart_image_url may fail — use capture_chart_snapshot for live chart. read-only.

tools.name: get_trading_style
tools.description: Current trading style + style list (scalp/day/swing/position). When: session start to show options to user. read-only.

tools.name: set_trading_style
tools.description: Set trading style · scalp/day/swing/position. When: after asking user. For scalp pass scalp_max_trades (trade cap). side-effect: updates settings. Example: trading_style=scalp&scalp_max_trades=5.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: When: quick analysis of one pair. RSI/MACD/SMA + trend. read-only. Do not use instead of get_ohlc for full indicators. Example: symbol=EURUSD&interval=1h.

tools.name: get_multi_timeframe_snapshot
tools.description: When: multi-timeframe analysis for one pair — fetches all frames in one parallel call (faster than get_market_snapshot per frame). read-only. Example: symbol=EURUSD&intervals=1h,15m,5m.

tools.name: get_market_price
tools.description: When: live price only. read-only. For forex check quoteAgeMs via get_ea_live_quotes. Example: symbol=EURUSD.

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: When: browse/search forex pairs via OANDA, or source=ea for full broker symbols via MT5 bridge (not Market Watch only). read-only. Example: market=forex&q=EUR or source=ea&q=XAU.

tools.name: get_chart_link
tools.description: When: live AiChart chart link for a pair to share with user. read-only. Example: symbol=EURUSD.

tools.name: get_market_context
tools.description: When: news/mood context. read-only. No side-effects. Example: symbol=EURUSD.

tools.name: scan_market
tools.description: scan market · compare symbols · best entry · pick a trade. When: 'take a trade' or 'best opportunity'. read-only. Example: symbols=[EURUSD,GBPUSD].

tools.name: get_ohlc
tools.description: When: before indicators/detect_levels. Forex via OANDA or EA. read-only. cursor/limit≤500. Example: symbol=EURUSD&interval=1h&limit=100.

tools.name: get_forex_indicators
tools.description: When: after get_ohlc. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ATR + trend. read-only. Not with stale quote. Example: symbol=EURUSD&interval=1h.

tools.name: detect_levels
tools.description: When: before SL/TP. Support/resistance + structure. read-only. Not a sole entry signal. Example: symbol=EURUSD&interval=4h&limit=120.

tools.name: connect_mt5
tools.description: Connect MetaTrader · MT5/MT4 link · forex connect · MetaApi login. When: MetaApi/mt5local — not with FOREX_BACKEND=ea. side-effect: saves credentials. Example: platform=mt5&server=...

tools.name: disconnect_mt5
tools.description: Disconnect MetaTrader · unlink MT5/MT4 · remove forex link. When: disconnect MetaApi/mt5local. side-effect: disconnect.

tools.name: get_mt5_status
tools.description: When: MetaApi/mt5local. With EA backend use get_ea_diagnostics. read-only.

tools.name: get_live_account
tools.description: When: before any trade — unified MT5 account + quoteAgeMs. read-only.

tools.name: get_ea_diagnostics
tools.description: When: forex EA — heartbeat, spread, retcodes. read-only. Example: symbol=EURUSD.

tools.name: get_ea_live_quotes
tools.description: When: before open_trade forex. isFresh, spreadPips, freshCount. read-only. Do not execute if stale.

tools.name: get_account_symbols
tools.description: All broker pairs/symbols in MetaTrader account (full Market Watch) with bid/ask/spread — see all available pairs, not a short list. Filters: q, market=forex. read-only. Example: market=forex.

tools.name: capture_mt5_chart
tools.description: When: re-capture MT5 with entry/SL/TP/drawings/recommendation_id (draw_and_capture, poll up to 30s). Ad-hoc chart without annotations → capture_chart_snapshot is faster.

tools.name: modify_sl_tp
tools.description: When: open MT5 position. side-effect: EA modify. Example: ticket=123&stop_loss=1.08.

tools.name: open_pending_order
tools.description: When: MT5 pending order. side-effect: EA pending. EA v3+.

tools.name: cancel_mt5_order
tools.description: When: cancel MT5 pending. side-effect: EA cancel.

tools.name: close_partial
tools.description: When: partial MT5 close. side-effect: EA partial close.

tools.name: query_mt5_terminal
tools.description: When: margin/equity/pending snapshot. read-only via EA.

tools.name: request_ea_reconnect
tools.description: When: stale quotes — once/minute max. side-effect: flags DB. resync_candles optional.

tools.name: list_chart_layouts
tools.description: When: before drawing — fetch user saved charts (id + symbol + link). read-only.

tools.name: get_chart_state
tools.description: When: read current user chart state (symbol/frame/drawings/recommendation) before editing. read-only. Example: optional layout_id.

tools.name: show_live_chart
tools.description: When: show live mini chart card in chat (candles refresh ~every 4s + Claude drawings and recommendation on chart). read-only — does not draw or execute. Pass symbol or layout_id; defaults to user primary chart.

tools.name: draw_on_chart
tools.description: When: draw directly on user live chart (TradingView) — supports all tools: lines/channels/zones/fibonacci/patterns/long-short positions/forecast, with colors, width, and style. Drawings appear on user screen within seconds without refresh. mode=set replaces, add appends. Pass recommendation for full trade box (entry/stop/targets).

tools.name: clear_chart_drawings
tools.description: When: clear all user chart drawings and recommendation. Does not touch candles or manual TradingView drawings.

tools.name: run_market_analysis
tools.description: When: full AI analysis for a pair (same as platform Analyze button): recommendation + technical drawings auto-drawn on user chart when layout_id passed. Consumes user credits (4). May take up to 120 seconds.
